entry.title: OxZygen 0.8.1
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.8.1 ## What's new - **20 new presets for melodies and chords**, ethereal and sparkling but made to play: they speak the moment you hit a pad and hold steady pitch, so chords stay sweet and fast lines come through. entry.title: OxZygen 0.8.0
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.8.0 ## What's new - **New Player page: the chamber.** The main page is now a metal chamber: the eight knobs sit on two wall panels, and the vents on the back wall glow with the sound (brighter as you play louder, fading out when you stop). entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.6
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.7.6 ## What's new - **Seven new recorded instruments**, in two new sound categories on the SOUND page: - **Keys:** grand piano, electric piano, concert harp. - **Mallets:** glockenspiel, hand chimes, kalimba, marimba. - They work like the bells: Decay, Shimmer and Tone knobs, and they layer with any other sound. entry.title: OxZygen 0.7.5
entry.summary: # OxZygen v0.7.5 ## What's new - **Mono output option:** in Logic (and other hosts) the plugin can also go on a mono instrument track; the sound is the stereo sound folded to one channel. - **Browse page:** a new BROWSE tab with the categories on the left (All, Voices, Winds, Brass, Strings, Bells, Synth, Air) and that category's presets on the right.
